# 📝 Update file: {NAME} · Task {TASK_ID} · {TIME}

1. **Status:** done / partly done / stuck
2. **What I finished:** {bullets + proof it works, e.g. "vision tests pass"}
3. **What's not done yet:** {what's left + the exact next step}
4. **What I tried that didn't work:** {so nobody repeats it}
5. **Problems or questions for the main laptop:**
6. **Overrides I made:** {what, why, who it affects — or "none"}
7. **Anything other people should know:** {e.g. "I changed how hand data is labeled"}
8. **Am I coming back to this?** yes/no, roughly when
9. **Remaining Claude usage:** {auto-filled}
10. **Human to-dos:** {things I promised to do · things only a human can do that I noticed}
